description: Fix critical integration bugs and security issues identified in semantic review: login content-type mismatch, admin role detection, client type enum mismatch, tax_id vs rfc, file download endpoint, payment amount validation, and audit log IP capture.
steps: Fix frontend login to send JSON with email field instead of form-encoded with username field
Fix frontend admin role detection to use role_name from backend response
Fix client type enum mismatch - align frontend values with backend enum
Fix frontend to send rfc instead of tax_id for client operations
Add file download endpoint for payment proofs (GET /api/payments/proofs/{proof_id}/download)
Replace raw file_path in PaymentProofResponse with download_url
Add Field(gt=0) constraint on payment amount in PaymentCreate schema
Add ip_address parameter passing in audit log calls via Request dependency
acceptance_criteria: Frontend login sends JSON body with email and password fields
Frontend correctly identifies admin users via role_name field
Frontend sends correct client_type enum values matching backend
Frontend sends rfc field for client tax identifier
File download endpoint exists and serves files with auth check
PaymentProofResponse returns download_url instead of raw file_path
Payment amount rejects negative or zero values
Audit log captures client IP address
verification: cd backend && export PYENV_VERSION=3.11.15 && pytest tests/ -v
